english.note: Use this all-purpose colloquial expression for a very small or residual amount.
Use this for a very small amount, especially in cooking instructions such as adding a dash of vinegar.
This is the all-purpose colloquial choice for a small amount; use it for a small number only when the context makes that clear.
Use this as the all-purpose noun for a small amount or a tiny adjustment.
Use this for a very small amount of something, especially in everyday phrases such as 少少芥末.
Use 少少 when the whisper means a very small amount of a flavor, quality, or other substance.
